subject: Novus Consulting — Onramp coach & operations playbook
messages:
From: Laura Griffin <laura@novus-consulting.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood-inference.com
Cc: matt.li@novus-consulting.com
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novus + Redwood — Onramp coach and ops playbook

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Novus is excited to pilot the consulting onramp program with Redwood — we spoke internally and want to formalize a two-week coach + ops enablement for 6 consultants, focused on:

- Hands-on integration patterns (webhooks, auth flows, data residency knobs)
- Field-ready runbooks for customer-facing troubleshooting
- Pricing & packaging alignment for joint go-to-market

Can you share a proposed agenda and who from Redwood would lead the sessions? Also attaching our standard partner onboarding SLA (stub) so you can see timing constraints.

We have target dates the week of Nov 13; flexible on two half-days or three shorter sessions.

Appreciate it — Laura

Attachments: Novus_Onboarding_SLA_v1.pdf (1 page stub)

---

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood-inference.com
To: Laura Griffin <laura@novus-consulting.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com, matt.li@novus-consulting.com
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus + Redwood — Onramp coach and ops playbook

Laura — great to hear and excited to run this. Quick notes and a sketch of ownership: 

1) Program scope (we'll tighten in the MAP doc)
   - Day 1 (half-day): Architecture & integration patterns (lead: Ben Carter, Solutions Eng)
   - Day 2 (half-day): Ops and troubleshooting runbooks + live troubleshooting lab (lead: Marissa Cole, Partner Ops)
   - Optional follow-up (1 hour): Pricing + GTM alignment with Sean Gallagher (Channel Sales)

2) Prep work (Novus): share a representative customer use case and any sandbox API keys by Nov 6.
3) Deliverables (Redwood): session slide decks, lab exercises, a one-page runbook template, and an enablement recording.
4) Logistics: We can do two half-days (Nov 14 & 15) 9:00–13:00 PT or three 90-minute sessions across Nov 14–16. Tell us preference.

I've attached a rough playbook/presentation we use for partner onramps. Ben, Marissa, Sean — can you confirm availability and whether we need a deeper security/compliance slot?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: Onramp_Teaching_Playbook.pptx (slides + labs)

From: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood-inference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com, Laura Griffin <laura@novus-consulting.com>, Matt Li <matt.li@novus-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Oct 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus + Redwood — Onramp coach and ops playbook

Vanessa — I can cover the integration patterns and the live lab. Two quick asks:

1) For the lab we should provision a shared sandbox with sample tokens that expire after the sessions (security requirement). Novus, can your infra team create test accounts or provide a test customer payload?
2) If Novus wants an optional deep-dive on model quantization or latency tuning for heavy token workloads, I can add a 30-minute add-on.

Available Nov 14 (AM) and Nov 15 (AM).

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood-inference.com

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: Laura Griffin <laura@novus-consulting.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood-inference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com, matt.li@novus-consulting.com
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus + Redwood — Onramp coach and ops playbook

Laura / team — confirming we will run Nov 14 & 15, 09:00–13:00 PT both days. Agenda and prework below. Please review and confirm by EOD Nov 6.

Prework (Novus):
- Provide one representative customer scenario and a matching dataset snippet (anonymized)
- Access: create two sandbox accounts or share ephemeral API tokens (valid through Nov 20)

Agenda (high level):
Day 1 — Integration patterns (Ben)
- 09:00–09:20: Welcome + goals (Vanessa)
- 09:20–10:30: Auth flows, routing policies, model variants (Ben)
- 10:30–11:00: Prefix & KV caching patterns (lab intro)
- 11:00–12:30: Live lab: connect sandbox -> simple chat integration (Ben)
- 12:30–13:00: Q&A & next steps

Day 2 — Ops & field runbooks (Marissa)
- 09:00–09:15: Recap + metrics to monitor (Marissa)
- 09:15–10:00: Troubleshooting playbook + incident triage steps (Marissa)
- 10:00–11:30: Runbook workshop: map customer flows -> runbook templates (breakouts)
- 11:30–12:15: Pricing check: basic packaging for reference installs (Sean)
- 12:15–13:00: Close + recording & handoff cadence (Vanessa)

Deliverables: slide decks, lab environment access, a recorded session, and a one-page post-run handoff with recommended next steps.

Attachments: Onramp_Teaching_Playbook.pptx, Novus_Onboarding_SLA_v1.pdf

Looking forward to it — Marissa
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
